add_highlight_circle: add a highlight circle at a 3D position with radius and optional color to client messages
add_line_between_positions: add a colored line between two 3D world positions in the client message buffer
show_modal_dialogue_box: show a modal dialog box with buttons and optional textbox to remote clients
update_camera_transform: update the camera translation and quaternion rotation for a viewport in client messages
draw_object_outline: draw an outline around specified objects with priority, color, and line width
